name: memory_salience
description: Manage the active salience profile — controls what matters to the agent. Operations: 'get' (view current profile), 'set' (replace profile), 'compute_boost' (preview importance boost for text), 'add_interest' (add interest topic), 'add_disinterest' (add dampened topic), 'set_persona' (set personality/identity context). Use this to personalize memory scoring for different users or agents.

operation.description: Operation to perform: get, set, compute_boost, add_interest, add_disinterest, set_persona.

text.description: Text to compute boost for (required for compute_boost).

topic.description: Interest/disinterest topic in natural language (required for add_interest, add_disinterest).

level.description: Interest level: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, IGNORE (for add_interest/add_disinterest).

stress_response.description: Stress response: ADAPTIVE, FIGHT, FLIGHT, FREEZE, FAWN (for set_persona).

icnu_interest.description: ICNU Interest weight (0.0-1.0) for set operation.

icnu_challenge.description: ICNU Challenge weight (0.0-1.0) for set operation.

icnu_novelty.description: ICNU Novelty weight (0.0-1.0) for set operation.

icnu_urgency.description: ICNU Urgency weight (0.0-1.0) for set operation.

agent_relevance_boost.description: Agent expertise relevance boost (1.0-1.8). Pre-computed scalar from agent soul expertise matching. Default 1.0 (no effect). Set higher to boost memories matching the agent's domain expertise.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
